descriptions: THE DEFENSE THREAT REDUCTION AGENCY (DTRA) AND THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE (DOD) HAVE A NEED TO EXPAND THE DEVELOPMENT OF ADVANCED BIOLOGICAL DETECTION AND DECONTAMINATION TECHNOLOGIES. THE NATIONAL STRATEGIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE (NSRI) IN COLLABORATION WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF NEBRASKA MEDICAL CENTER (UNMC), THE UNIVERSITY OF NEBRASKA LINCOLN (UNL) AND THE BIOLOGICAL DEFENSE RESEARCH DIRECTORATE (BDRD) OF THE NAVY WILL SCREEN NOVEL ACTIVE MATERIAL THAT CAN BE SHOWN TO TARGET AND DISRUPT GROWTH AND/OR KILL HARMFUL BACTERIA AND VIRUSES FOR USE IN BOTH REMEDIATION OF BIOLOGICAL CONTAMINATION AND FOR DETECTION OF HARMFUL BACTERIA AND VIRUSES, INCLUDING AGENTS OF CONCERN FOR BIOLOGICAL WARFARE AND TERRORISM AND AGENTS THAT PRESENT SIGNIFICANT HEALTH RISKS TO ACTIVE MILITARY FORCES. IN ADDITION, THIS TEAM WILL WORK TO PRODUCE FUNCTIONAL PRODUCTS FROM THIS NOVEL ACTIVE MATERIAL TO MEET THE NEEDS OF DTRA AND OTHER DOD STAKEHOLDERS. THE PROJECT WILL BE BROKEN INTO THREE (3) PRIMARY OBJECTIVES: 1. ISOLATION AND CHARACTERIZATION OF NOVEL MATERIALS; 2. PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT; 3. USE CASE DEVELOPMENT. UNDER THIS TO, NU/NSRI, U.S. STRATEGIC COMMAND (USSTRATCOM), AND ITS UARC PARTNERS WILL PROVIDE THE NATION WITH RESEARCH EFFORTS CENTERED ON CORE COMPETENCY: #3 ACTIVE AND PASSIVE DEFENSE AGAINST WEAPONS OF MASS DESTRUCTION, INCLUDING COUNTERMEASURES TO CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM DISORDERS; RAPID PRODUCTION OF VACCINES FOR BIO-AGENTS; NEXT GENERATION RESPIRATORY PROTECTION EQUIPMENT; GENETIC, IMMUNOLOGICAL, AND MATERIALS APPROACHES TO DEVELOP AND DELIVER VACCINE ANTIGENS IN A MANNER TO ENHANCE THEIR CELLULAR UPTAKE; REGULATION OF THE METABOLIC PROCESS FOR WARFIGHTERS IN EXTREME ENVIRONMENTS; MATERIALS DEVELOPMENT AND DESIGN FOR PERSONNEL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT AND OTHER PROTECTIVE MEASURES; AND INNOVATIVE APPROACHES TO DRUG DELIVERY.
